report:
WarriorCon 6 — report for Nov 10 (updated Nov 11, 7:41am ET)

SUMMARY
• 3 new tickets yesterday (137 total, 21 days to go)
• Win: 69 of 137 ticket holders (50.4%) signed up for the Warrior App (free until Dec 4)
• Watch: promote text failures 28.4% to date (22,918 of 80,576 texts failed), above 5%

LEFT TO SEND (until Dec 2)
Promote: 6 emails · 6 texts — next: about Wed Nov 11, 11:31am ET
Ticket holders: 7 emails · 2 texts — next: Wed Nov 11, 11:30am ET

TICKET HOLDERS: 137 (134 paid + 3 comps) · 3 new yesterday
$28,541 total sales ($26,666 tickets + $1,875 Business Bible)
103 of 134 tickets were bought within 48 hrs of an email/text

PROMOTE (non-ticket holders)
Yesterday — Email: 22,670 sent · 28.1% open · 0.3% click
Yesterday — SMS: 3,605 sent · 82.0% delivered
To date — Email: 409,786 sent · 31.4% open · 0.3% click
To date — SMS: 80,576 sent · 71.3% delivered

POST-TICKET SEDUCTION (ticket holders)
Yesterday — Email: 119 sent · 47.1% open
Yesterday — SMS: 94 sent · 88.3% delivered
To date — Email: 342 sent · 46.8% open
To date — SMS: 94 sent · 88.3% delivered

UPSELLS
Warrior App (Power Plan): 69 · 50.4% of ticket holders
Business Bible: 17 sales · $1,875 · bought by 16 of 134 paid buyers (11.9%)
(Texts have no open rate.)
